summary: The Department of Defense reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 pertaining to off-road vehicles on public lands and found it satisfactory. The letter is brief and offers no specific objections or recommendations, simply indicating the Department's approval of the statement as submitted.

statement.text:
ASSISTANT SECRETARY OF DEFENSE 
WASHINGTON, D. C. 20301
Mr. G. Douglas Hofe, Jr. Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation United States Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Hofe:
This is in response to your letter dated June 1, 1972 requesting the Department of Defense comments on your draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644.
The draft environmental statement is satisfactory to the Department of Defense.
Sincerely,
Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense (Environmental Quality)
